A birthday note · Just for you

Dear Keshali,

Wishing you a birthday filled with the kind of happiness that stays long after the candles are out. May the year ahead bring you new reasons to smile, lovely surprises, peaceful days, and dreams that find their way to you.

May you discover more of what makes you happy, grow in all the ways that matter to you, and never forget how much possibility one new year can hold.

Keep being wonderfully you. You deserve all the good things coming your way.

With warmest wishes, ♡
